40000.name: NoAdditionalTermBondRefs
40000.description: Number of bonds in the repeating group.

40002.name: AdditionalTermBondSecurityIDSource
40002.description: Identifies the source scheme of the AdditionalTermBondSecurityID(40001) value.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

40004.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDescLen
40004.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc(40005) field.

40005.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc
40005.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field.

40006.name: AdditionalTermBondCurrency
40006.description: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40008.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
40008.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer(40009) field.

40009.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer
40009.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field.

40010.name: AdditionalTermBondSeniority
40010.description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

40012.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponRate
40012.description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

40013.name: AdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
40013.description: The maturity date of the bond.

40014.name: AdditionalTermBondParValue
40014.description: The par value of the bond.

40015.name: AdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
40015.description: Total issued amount of the bond.

40016.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
40016.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

40017.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
40017.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

40018.name: AdditionalTermBondDayCount
40018.description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

40019.name: NoAdditionalTerms
40019.description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

40020.name: AdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
40020.description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

40021.name: AdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
40021.description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

40022.name: NoCashSettlTerms
40022.description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

40023.name: CashSettlCurrency
40023.description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlAmount(40034) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40024.name: CashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
40024.description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for the purpose of cash settlement.

40026.name: CashSettlBusinessCenter
40026.description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40027.name: CashSettlQuoteMethod
40027.description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

40028.name: CashSettlQuoteAmount
40028.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

40029.name: CashSettlQuoteCurrency
40029.description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlQuoteAmount(40028) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

40030.name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
40030.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

40031.name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
40031.description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount(40030) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

40032.name: CashSettlDealer
40032.description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

40033.name: CashSettlBusinessDays
40033.description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

40034.name: CashSettlAmount
40034.description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

40035.name: CashSettlRecoveryFactor
40035.description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - CashSettlRecoveryFactor(40035)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

40036.name: CashSettlFixedTermIndicator
40036.description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

40037.name: CashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
40037.description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in CashSettlAmount(40034). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest.

40038.name: CashSettlValuationMethod
40038.description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

40039.name: CashSettlTermXID
40039.description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

40040.name: NoContractualDefinitions
40040.description: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

40041.name: ContractualDefinition
40041.description: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

40042.name: NoContractualMatrices
40042.description: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

40043.name: ContractualMatrixSource
40043.description: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

40044.name: ContractualMatrixDate
40044.description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

40045.name: ContractualMatrixTerm
40045.description:
Specifies the applicable key into the relevant contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the ContractualMatrixTerm(40045) is not applicable and is to be omitted.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

40046.name: NoFinancingTermSupplements
40046.description: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

40047.name: FinancingTermSupplementDesc
40047.description: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

40048.name: FinancingTermSupplementDate
40048.description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

40049.name: NoStreams
40049.description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

40051.name: StreamDesc
40051.description: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

40052.name: StreamPaySide
40052.description: The side of the party paying the stream.

40053.name: StreamReceiveSide
40053.description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

40054.name: StreamNotional
40054.description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use the PaymentScheduleGrp component to specify the rate steps.

40055.name: StreamCurrency
40055.description: Specifies the currency the StreamNotional(40054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40056.name: StreamText
40056.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

40058.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
40058.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

40059.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
40059.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40060.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
40060.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40061.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
40061.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

40062.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
40062.description: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

40063.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
40063.description: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

40066.name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
40066.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40067.name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
40067.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40068.name: StreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
40068.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40069.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
40069.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

40070.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
40070.description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

40071.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
40071.description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

40073.name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
40073.description: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40074.name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
40074.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40075.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
40075.description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

40076.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
40076.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40077.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
40077.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40078.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
40078.description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

40079.name: StreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
40079.description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

40080.name: StreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
40080.description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

40081.name: StreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
40081.description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

40082.name: StreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
40082.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

40083.name: StreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
40083.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

40084.name: StreamCalculationRollConvention
40084.description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40085.name: NoSettlRateFallbacks
40085.description: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

40086.name: SettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
40086.description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

40087.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
40087.description: Identifies the source of the rate information.

40088.name: SettlRatePostponementSurvey
40088.description: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

40089.name: SettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
40089.description: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

40090.name: NoProvisions
40090.description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

40092.name: ProvisionDateUnadjusted
40092.description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

40093.name: ProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
40093.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40094.name: ProvisionDateBusinessCenter
40094.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40095.name: ProvisionDateAdjusted
40095.description: The adjusted date of the provision.

40096.name: ProvisionDateTenorPeriod
40096.description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

40097.name: ProvisionDateTenorUnit
40097.description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

40098.name: ProvisionCalculationAgent
40098.description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in ProvisionCalculationAgent(40098) or in the ProvisionParties component.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

40099.name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
40099.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

40100.name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
40100.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

40101.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
40101.description: The instrument provision option’s exercise style.

40102.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
40102.description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

40103.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
40103.description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40104.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
40104.description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40105.name: ProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
40105.description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40106.name: ProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
40106.description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

40107.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
40107.description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

40108.name: ProvisionCashSettlMethod
40108.description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

40109.name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency
40109.description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40110.name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
40110.description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40111.name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
40111.description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

40112.name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
40112.description: Identifies the source of quote information.

40113.name: ProvisionText
40113.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

40114.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTime
40114.description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

40115.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
40115.description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40116.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
40116.description: The cash settlement valuation date adjustment business day convention. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40117.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
40117.description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40118.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
40118.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values

40119.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
40119.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

40120.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
40120.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

40121.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
40121.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

40122.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
40122.description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

40123.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
40123.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40124.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
40124.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40125.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
40125.description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

40126.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
40126.description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

40127.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
40127.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

40128.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
40128.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

40129.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
40129.description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

40130.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
40130.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40131.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
40131.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

40132.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
40132.description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

40133.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
40133.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

40134.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
40134.description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

40135.name: ProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
40135.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

40136.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
40136.description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

40137.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
40137.description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

40138.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
40138.description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

40139.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
40139.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40140.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
40140.description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

40141.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
40141.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40142.name: NoProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
40142.description: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

40143.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
40143.description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40144).

40144.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
40144.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

40145.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
40145.description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

40146.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
40146.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40147.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
40147.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40148.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
40148.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40149.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
40149.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

40150.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
40150.description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

40151.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
40151.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

40152.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
40152.description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

40153.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTime
40153.description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

40154.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
40154.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40155.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
40155.description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

40156.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
40156.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40157.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
40157.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40158.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
40158.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40159.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
40159.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40160.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
40160.description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40161.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
40161.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40162.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
40162.description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

40163.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
40163.description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

40164.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
40164.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40165.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
40165.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40166.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
40166.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

40167.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
40167.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

40168.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
40168.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

40169.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
40169.description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

40170.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
40170.description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

40171.name: NoProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
40171.description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

40172.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
40172.description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40173).

40173.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
40173.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

40174.name: NoProvisionPartyIDs

40328.name: LegPaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
40328.description: Specifies the currency in which LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40327) or LegPaymentStreamRate(40326) is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40329.name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
40329.description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

40330.name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
40330.description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

40331.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex
40331.description: The payment stream floating rate index.

40332.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
40332.description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

40333.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
40333.description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

40334.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
40334.description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

40335.name: LegPaymentStreamRateMultiplier
40335.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

40336.name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpread
40336.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex(40331).

40337.name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
40337.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

40338.name: LegPaymentStreamRateTreatment
40338.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

40339.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRate
40339.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

40340.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
40340.description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

40341.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
40341.description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

40342.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRate
40342.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

40343.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
40343.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

40344.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
40344.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

40345.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialRate
40345.description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

40347.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
40347.description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

40348.name: LegPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
40348.description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

40349.name: LegPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
40349.description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

40350.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
40350.description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determineds the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

40351.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
40351.description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

40352.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
40352.description: The inflation lag period day type.

40353.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod

40378.description: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

40381.description: The notional value for this step schedule, or amount of a cashflow payment.

40383.name: LegPaymentScheduleRate
40383.description: The rate value for this step schedule.

40385.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpread
40385.description: The spread value for this step schedule.

40386.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
40386.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

40387.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateTreatment
40387.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

40388.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedAmount
40388.description: The explicit payment amount for this step schedule.

40389.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
40389.description: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40390.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
40390.description: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

40391.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
40391.description: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

40392.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
40392.description: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

40394.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
40394.description: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

40395.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
40395.description: Specifies whether the LegPaymentScheduleStepRate(40393) or LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40392) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

40397.name: LegPaymentScheduleWeight

40398.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo

40400.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter

40406.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter

40407.description:

40409.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter

40418.name: NoLegPaymentStubs
40418.description: Number of stubs in the repeating group

40420.name: LegPaymentStubLength

40421.description: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

40422.name: LegPaymentStubFixedAmount
40422.description: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

40423.name: LegPaymentStubFixedCurrency

40425.description: The source for the stub floating rate index.

40427.description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

40430.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
40430.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

40431.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
40431.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the stub index.

40432.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. 40433.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide

40434.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide

40436.name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
40436.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

40437.name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide

40447.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2FloorRate

40455.description: Time unit associated with the leg provision's tenor period.

40457.name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide

40458.name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
40458.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

40459.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
40459.description: The instrument provision option exercise style.

40460.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
40460.description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

40461.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
40461.description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40462.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
40462.description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40463.name: LegProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
40463.description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

40464.name: LegProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
40464.description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

40465.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
40465.description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

40466.name: LegProvisionCashSettlMethod
40466.description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

40467.name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency
40467.description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40468.name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
40468.description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

40469.name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
40469.description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

40470.name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
40470.description: Identifies the source of quote information.

40471.name: BusinessCenter

40472.name: LegProvisionText
40472.description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

40473.name: NoLegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
40473.description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

40474.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
40474.description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40521).

40475.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType

40476.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
40476.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

40477.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
40477.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40478.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
40478.description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

40479.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
40479.description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

40480.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
40480.description: Time unit multiplier for subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

40481.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
40481.description: Time unit associated with subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

40482.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
40482.description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

40483.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
40483.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40484.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
40484.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

40485.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
40485.description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

40486.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
40486.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

40487.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
40487.description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

40488.name: LegProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
40488.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

40489.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
40489.description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

40490.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
40490.description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

40491.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
40491.description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

40492.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
40492.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40493.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
40493.description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. 40494.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
40494.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

40495.name: NoLegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates

40496.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate

40497.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
40497.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

40498.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted

40499.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
40499.description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

40500.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
40500.description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO".

40501.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
40501.description:

40502.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
40502.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

40503.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
40503.description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

40504.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
40504.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

40505.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
40505.description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

40506.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTime

40507.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
40507.description:

40510.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter

40511.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo

40512.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
40512.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40513.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
40513.description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40514.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
40514.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

40515.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
40515.description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

40516.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention

40517.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter

40518.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
40518.description:

See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

40519.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
40519.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

40520.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit

40523.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
40523.description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

40525.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter

40632.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.
